name: positron-atlas
description: Interactive UMAP scatter plots of high-dimensional DataFrames in Positron.

positronAtlas.maxAnchors.description: Maximum number of rows UMAP runs on in the browser when WebGPU is available. Remaining rows are placed by nearest-anchor projection in the kernel.

positronAtlas.maxAnchorsCpu.description: Maximum number of anchor rows when UMAP runs on the CPU (no WebGPU). CPU UMAP takes about 0.7 ms per row for 200 epochs.

positronAtlas.useWebGpu.description: Run UMAP on the GPU (WebGPU) when available; falls back to the CPU automatically.

positronAtlas.anchorBudget.description: Maximum number of values (anchors × dimensions) sent to the browser UMAP.

positronAtlas.defaultSamplePct.description: Default percentage of rows to sample.

positronAtlas.pcaEnabled.description: Apply PCA before UMAP by default.

positronAtlas.nativeCore.description: Place rows with the bundled Rust core (much faster). Turn off to use the numpy code; Atlas also falls back to numpy when this platform has no Rust core.

enumDescriptions: Ask once before downloading each new font family from Google Fonts.
Always download Google Fonts without asking.
Never download from Google Fonts; only bundled and cached fonts are available.
positronAtlas.downloadGoogleFonts.description: Whether to download font files from Google Fonts on demand. Each download sends the font family name and your IP address to Google.

positronAtlas.maxLazyRows.description: Maximum number of rows collected from a lazy frame (polars LazyFrame, DuckDB relation, etc.) when opening it in Atlas.

positronAtlas.neighborCacheMB.description: Memory budget (MB) for the nearest-anchor neighbour cache. When a placement result fits within this budget (n_rows × k × 8 bytes), Atlas pre-computes neighbours during prepare and reuses them on subsequent placements with the same metric and k, skipping the index build and search entirely. Set to 0 to disable.

enumDescriptions: **Data map** (default): scroll to zoom, left-drag to pan, right-drag to rotate (2D only).
**Molecular viewer**: scroll to zoom, left-drag to pan/rotate, like PyMOL.
**3D / CAD**: scroll to zoom, middle-drag to pan, left-drag to orbit.
**Design**: Ctrl+scroll / pinch to zoom, Space+drag to pan, like Figma or Sketch.
positronAtlas.navigation.preset.markdownDescription:
Navigation interaction preset. Affects which mouse buttons pan vs. orbit/rotate.

- `dataMap`: scroll = zoom, left-drag = pan, right-drag = rotate (2D)
- `molecular`: scroll = zoom, left-drag = pan/orbit
- `cad`: scroll = zoom, middle-drag = pan, left-drag = orbit
- `design`: Ctrl+scroll = zoom, Space+drag = pan

enumDescriptions: **Zoom** (default): scroll wheel zooms in and out.
**Pan**: scroll wheel pans the map; horizontal two-finger swipe pans horizontally.
positronAtlas.navigation.scrollGesture.markdownDescription:
What the scroll wheel (or two-finger trackpad swipe) does over the map.

- `zoom` (default): scroll to zoom in/out
- `pan`: scroll to pan up/down

positronAtlas.navigation.zoomToCursor.markdownDescription: When **enabled** (default), zooming keeps the point under the cursor stationary — like a geographic map. When **disabled**, the view always zooms toward the view center.

positronAtlas.navigation.invertZoom.markdownDescription: **Invert** the scroll-to-zoom direction. By default, scrolling up / pinching out zooms in. Enable this to reverse that direction.

positronAtlas.navigation.emulateMiddleBu.markdownDescription: Treat **Alt + left-drag** as a middle-button drag. Useful with the `cad` preset on a laptop trackpad that has no physical middle button.
